purpose: Read-only native keyframe scatter audit for Root598 typed590 A080/A120.

runtime_reads.trajectory_h5: producer-attested input; only registered Root142 worker opens it
runtime_reads.identity: UID/type/valid are checked from original saved rows; no generated particles
runtime_reads.time: exact H5 time dataset values are reported for each selected frame
runtime_reads.mk: native saved Mk field; Mk50 is reported as a source marker, not inferred from type

plot_outputs.velocity: native velocity magnitude m/s with fixed display scale 0.0..0.6
plot_outputs.initial_overlay: original frame-0 fluid positions only; display comparison, not a free-surface reconstruction
